name: Simple Template: Chthonic Creature (CR +varies)
body:
Challenge Rating: A chthonic creature’s CR increases by 1 only if the base creature has 5 or more HD.

Type: The creature gains the earth subtype

Senses: gains darkvision 60 ft.

Defensive Abilities: gains DR and resistance to acid as noted on the table below

Speed: gains a burrow speed equal to half its highest speed (its tunnels always collapses behind it and never leave behind a usable passage)

Attacks: gains bonus acid damage as noted on the table below on attacks with natural weapons.

Hit Dice	Damage Reduction	Resist Acid	Acid Damage
1–4	—	10	1 point
5–10	3/—	15	1d6
11+	5/—	20	2d6
